## Peer-reviewed articles

::: {.publication-card}
### Automated Retrieval and Analysis of Finnish Cultural Metadata with *finna* (2026)

**Akewak Jeba**, Julia Matveeva, Leo Lahti · *Data Science Journal*, 25(1).

A reproducible software and workflow contribution for retrieving and analyzing large-scale Finnish cultural heritage metadata through the Finna API.

::: {.publication-links}
[Article](https://doi.org/10.5334/dsj-2026-027) [finna documentation](https://fennicahub.github.io/finna)
:::
:::

## Scientific software

- **finna** — R client for the Finna API and cultural heritage metadata workflows.
- **LimROTS** — Bioconductor package for robust differential expression analysis.
- **iSEEtree** — interactive exploration of hierarchical biological data.
